steps.task: Implement server-side CSS filter emulation (brightness, contrast, saturate, hueRotate, grayscale, sepia, blur)

sub_plan.description: Pixel-level filter operations matching CSS filter behavior

steps.task: Implement apply_brightness, apply_contrast, apply_saturate as per-pixel RGB operations on RgbaImage

knowledge.notes: brightness: multiply RGB by factor. contrast: (pixel - 128) * factor + 128. saturate: convert to HSL, multiply S, convert back. All values are CSS-style (1.0 = no change).

steps.task: Implement apply_hue_rotate (degrees), apply_grayscale (0-1), apply_sepia (0-1) as per-pixel operations

knowledge.notes: hueRotate: rotate hue in HSL space by degrees. grayscale: luma = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B, lerp toward gray. sepia: standard sepia matrix. All match CSS filter spec.

steps.task: Implement apply_blur using image crate's blur() or imageproc gaussian_blur_f32

knowledge.notes: CSS blur is Gaussian. image::imageops::blur(img, sigma) should work. Map CSS blur px value to sigma.

steps.task: Create apply_all_filters(img, OverlayFilterParams) that chains all filters in CSS filter order

knowledge.notes: CSS applies filters in declaration order. Frontend buildFilterString order: brightness, contrast, saturate, hue-rotate, grayscale, sepia, blur. Apply in same order. Skip filter if value equals default (1.0 for most, 0 for hueRotate/grayscale/sepia/blur).

decisions: Full server-side overlay rendering — backend applies all overlay params in Rust
knowledge.notes: This is the most complex step. Must match frontend CSS filter rendering as closely as possible.

output.summary: Completed: Implement server-side CSS filter emulation (brightness, contrast, saturate, hueR

steps.task: Implement server-side text rendering with shadow, logo rendering, and auto-fit text

sub_plan.description: Replicate frontend drawOverlayOnCanvas in Rust: text elements, logo, shadows, auto-fit

steps.task: Implement draw_overlay_text: parse hex color, resolve font from (fontWeight, fontStyle), position at (x%, y%) of canvas, draw shadow first (offset + blur + color) then main text. Use ab_glyph + imageproc draw_text_mut.

knowledge.notes: Frontend drawText: fontSize = size% of canvas, x = x% of canvas - textWidth/2, y = y% of canvas - fontSize/2. Shadow drawn first with offset and blur. Text drawn with textBaseline='top' equivalent.

steps.task: Implement draw_overlay_logo: load moafunk.png from assets/brand/, contain-fit within size% box centered at (x%, y%), alpha_blend onto canvas

knowledge.notes: Frontend drawLogo: maxDim = size% of canvas, contain-fit (scale to fit within maxDim×maxDim preserving aspect), center at (x%, y%). Logo at assets/brand/moafunk.png.

steps.task: Implement draw_entity_name with binary-search auto-fit: find max font size that fits within 35% canvas width, render centered at (x%, y%)

knowledge.notes: Frontend drawArtistName: binary search font size (min 10, max size% of canvas) until text width <= 35% of canvas width. Uses same draw + shadow logic as drawText.

steps.task: Create apply_overlay_preset(img, OverlayParams, entity_name): apply filters → draw UN → draw HEARD → draw logo → draw entity name. Returns RgbaImage.

knowledge.notes: Frontend renderPreview order: crop → apply filter → draw overlay elements (un, heard, logo, artistName). Only draw elements where visible=true. Return final composed image.

decisions: All text comes from overlay preset — plain collage has no text
knowledge.notes: Must match frontend useOverlayRenderer.ts rendering as closely as possible for visual consistency.

output.summary: Completed: Implement server-side text rendering with shadow, logo rendering, and auto-fit t
